notes.title: Hush Hush High - Patch 103.1
notes.notes:
Added a cheat sheet to the game. It can be accessed from the pause menu while playing the game.
This should make it a lot easier for new players or returning players to learn the basics of the game quickly.

notes.title: Hush Hush High - Patch 103
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029048/9e70c941a3e1da13cc2e82c51e51ec399ddcbe96.png[/img]

The 3rd update for Hush Hush High is finally out! This includes a bunch of improvements to the tutorial and the overall game to improve player experience.

Gameplay Improvements:
[list]
[*]Minimap updated with more room names and symbols to make it easier find your way across the high school.
[*]Added telegraphs at the start of boss encounters making it easier to understand the minigame.
[*]Objective markers are now animated so they are easier to find.
[*][spoiler]Added additional cooldown to the annoying kid.[/spoiler]
[/list]
Tutorial Improvements:
[list]
[*]Shorter tutorial!
[*]Added additional information to further clarify the game mechanics to the player.
[*]Tutorial button is now shown to the player in case they want to play/replay it later.
[*]Added feedback on completing the tutorial.
[/list]
Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*]PS4/Steamdeck Controller bugs in several menus have been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Hush Hush High - Patch 102
notes.notes:
Here's the 2nd update for Hush Hush High! Based on further feedback and suggestions we have improved some parts of the game that were unclear in the previous versions.

Adjustments to the pulling back minigame!
[list]
[*]The pulling back minigame now shows a marker under Mochi to denote the player's current position. This should reduce confusion during the minigame.
[*]Scripted fails in the tutorials are failed instantly instead of triggering an impossible minigame. This change was made to reduce confusion during the tutorial.
[/list]
Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed some smaller issues in the pull back minigame win condition (mainly for the "No Button Mashing" option)
[/list]

notes.title: Hush Hush High - Patch 101
notes.notes:
Thanks to a bunch of people trying out the game, we got some feedback on issues with the game. This is our first patch fixing some major issues remaining in the game.

Minor improvements and additions to the tutorial!
[list]
[*]Tutorial now tells you about Mochi vending machines.
[/list]
Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed certain walls that allowed players to walk through.
[*]Fixed bug that stopped certain achievements from triggering.
[/list]
